name: static_fan_out_joins_all_branches
workflow:
digraph T {
  start [shape=Mdiamond]
  exit [shape=Msquare]

  fork [shape=component]
  a [prompt="x"]
  b [prompt="x"]
  merge [shape=tripleoctagon]
  report [prompt="x"]
  start -> fork
  fork -> a
  fork -> b
  a -> merge
  b -> merge
  merge -> report -> exit

}
departure: Fabro records the branches as parallel branch events, not stages, so its path omits `a` and `b`. Under Petri each branch runs in a child invocation whose stage keeps a final record, so the path lists `a` and `b` in branch order between `fork` and `merge`. Branch context is kept under parallel.results and never merges into the parent context, matching Fabro: the recorded context is empty on both sides.
